listings.description:
ENDS WITH AN AI GROWTH EVAL — the page no other intervention binder has. Your student reads the ten-word probe, you record the score, and the Growth Eval tells you what that score means and the next three moves to make this week. It works with zero technology: the score ranges and their next steps are printed right on the page. If you do use an AI assistant, there is a ready-to-paste prompt that uses de-identified data only — a grade and a pattern, never a name, never a class list, and never the student at a keyboard. A second page does the same for a whole small group.

THE COMPLETE BINDER, 52 PAGES. Five units — short a, i, o, u, e — with six practice pages each: read it/build it/write it with pictures, then again without pictures, sound boxes, picture-and-word match, word-family sorting, and sentence reading. Every unit ends with a ten-word probe on its own student-facing page and a four-week data sheet. A mixed-review probe at the back checks all five vowels together, so you can see which one needs another pass.

NO PREP. Print once, sleeve the practice pages, hand out a dry-erase marker, and the binder lasts all year.

THE SCOPE AND SEQUENCE IS PRINTED INSIDE so you can slot this into whatever phonics program you already teach instead of guessing what it assumes. Short a first because it appears in more early decodable words than any other short vowel; short e last because e and i are the pair students most often confuse.

EVERY TARGET WORD IS A TRUE CVC WORD — one consonant, one short vowel, one consonant, no blends and no digraphs — verified by an automated check before publication, and every unit checked so no word leaks in from another vowel.

WHAT WE ARE NOT CLAIMING: this is not aligned to, affiliated with, or a substitute for any named phonics program, and it is not a diagnostic assessment. It is practice material and a set of ten-word progress checks.
